notes: Agent environment has no scriptable mouse/scroll input, so this is an idle-Servers-view capture (no expanded rows) rather than the documented interactive scroll smoke. Compared against a same-methodology, same-machine, same-duration baseline capture of feature/unified-backlog-view (0a9cbcf) at effectively the same scale (84 rows/348 services/61 listeners vs this run's 83/348/65): baseline total p95 1.026ms, p99 1.162ms vs this run's 1.35ms / 1.38ms. Both are two orders of magnitude under the 16.7ms frame budget; the ~0.3ms delta is consistent with normal process-to-process variance at sub-millisecond scale, not a structural regression — the task-14/15/16 changes touching this path are a per-frame theme::apply() call (documented as a cheap Visuals swap) and mechanical Color32-constant-to-accessor-function renames, neither of which does meaningful work. New Board/Milestones/Statistics Backlog lenses only render when that lens is active and never touch the Servers/workspace path.
